svg.text: Mercenaries 2 — the camera-matrix path and where MC2VR overwrites it
g_CameraTable (union HMD pose: camera + culling + LOD) → builder → VP record → per-eye delta at the GPU constants · two passes → OpenXR host
CAMERA MATRIX PATH (main thread, per frame)
Camera entity pose (heap record: quat + pos)
values originate in game logic / the VM — upstream ViewEntry fields are OUTPUT-only, injecting there fails
① UNION INJECTION — overwrite the just-filled entry
E' = S·L⁻¹·S·E (L = HMD local rotation; left multiply; S = measured row signs diag(−1,1,1))
position Δ = (−px·r0 + py·r1 − pz·r2) · view_world_scale (r_j = entry rows)
mid-point of the two eyes, sampled once per game frame · measured, not guessed
g_CameraTable now holds the HMD union pose
one source of truth: the builder AND the culling / fov readers both read it
→ Matrix_Copy3x4: g_CameraTable → stack camera entry (rotation +0x10..0x3c, position +0x40)
opaque — only ORCHESTRATES: calls the plaintext builder (thunk 0x00506a26)
never hooked; we write the data it reads (g_CameraTable) and the data it produces (records)
reads camera object: rotation rows · position · near/far · fovCos (+0x58)
4×4 matrix inverse FUN_008225c0 (call 0x008593db) → view matrix ← why E·M renders M⁻¹
builds the projection from the runtime tan-table (LH: clip.w = +z)
ViewContext record fill (once per frame, both double-buffer bases)
g_ViewContextTable: VP rows 0-3 | camPos | extra — ★ THE DRAW CAMERA ★ · unchanged between pass 1 and 2
EDI = current technique → exact viewContextData reg/count (+0xd4/+0xd8), ViewProj (+0xdc/+0xe0)
② PER-EYE DELTA — Dx9_SetVertexShaderConstantF → device slot 94
view_row_rewrite=hmd_delta: vp_camera::decompose the VP → per-eye OpenXR FOV projection
+ per-eye position/rotation delta relative to the same-frame union (camtable::get_union)
rows: w −= dot(row.xyz, D) · camPos: xyz += D · applied on a scratch copy, game buffer untouched
main pass only (RT0 == backbuffer size) · shadow / reflection / offscreen passes skipped
GPU: viewContextData VS constants → vertex shaders → draw
PS camera data (cameraPos c92, texgen matrices, slot 109) and shaders without viewContextData stay mono
culling frustum still uses the game's widescreen FOV (FOV widening pending)
SteamVR · head pose, eye FOV, IPD
no host ⇒ rewrite is a no-op
L at 1→2 · R at 2→0 → shared ring
Pink arrows = HMD pose/FOV flowing into the two overwrite points; blue/violet elbows = which pass supplies the eye; dashed violet = eye images to the OpenXR host.
Facts: the draw camera never exists in patchable plaintext data except as g_CameraTable (upstream) and the per-frame records / GPU constants (downstream) — the VM only orchestrates in between.
Sources: docs/stereo_improvements_plan.md (chain, entry convention) · docs/stereo_design.md · docs/reverse_engineering/render_path.md · docs/launcher_plan.md (hook sites).
